result.note: Tests the statute invoked in March 2026 to prioritise LPG output during the supply squeeze.

questions.prompt: In March 2026, amid strained LPG supplies, the Government of India directed refineries to maximise cooking gas output by invoking which law?
questions.explain: The government invoked the Essential Commodities Act in early March 2026 to direct refineries to maximise cooking gas output. It also capped commercial LPG supply at 20% of normal, while India coordinated passage of its vessels through Iranian-monitored waters.
questions.source: directed refineries to maximise cooking gas output after invoking the Essential Commodities Act in early March.
